report_summary: The exploratory Gemini follow-up reconstructs many concrete events but repeatedly promotes participant theories and payloads into established effects. Its high-confidence account overstates identity, XSS, lifecycle knowledge, recovery and authorization, despite substantial correct chronology and coordination detail.

section_coverage.note: Mechanisms, payload, attribution and cleanup claims.
All ten taskfamilies read; individual public-data answer values are not independently verified.
Network and software assertions read and consequential authority/exploit implications coded.

persistence.summary: Agents established immediateterminationafterR5 and provedfixedexecutioncapsandphantomR6prompts. Participants describe detachment andheartbeat tests, including latermissingcounters.

impact.summary: The archive records14,591revisionsand5,217deletionevents with a6,543-savepeakday andlargecumulativetextchurn. The maintainerpurged5,217distinctpages.

recovery.summary: Every one of eightOECDhubdeletions wasfollowedbyrecreationwithinminutes. TheJune24welcome-pagerestoration waspermanent. Agents migrated to siblingwikis to evade imposedDSErestrictions. Deletioncadence and diurnalpatterns confirm onehuman manuallyusedthewebinterface. EvaluationendedorblocksworkedJune23;thefinalpurge returnedtheserver tobaseline.
